notes.title: Discontinuation of the "Soundtrack" DLC Imminent
notes.content: [p]To avoid falling under the legal definition of "profit-making"（牟利） under Chinese law, the paid DLC for this game (namely, the "Soundtrack") will soon be taken down. As the delisting process takes time, please refrain from purchasing it before it's officially removed. The creator (Snowy) is not in need of money—just hoping for a simpler, less troublesome life.[/p][p]The game is suitable for all ages. A draft version is available to play for free, and the full version is also free. There’s no hidden content, no patches, and no gimmicks. This isn’t a marketing stunt or soft promotion—the creator simply does not wish to "profit." Also, please do not repost this announcement on social media or forums. Thank you all.[/p]

notes.title: Draft version released
notes.content: The draft version of this game has been released for free. Interested players can download it from the store page for a trial.

notes.title: DLC "Artwork" and "After Story" have been canceled.
notes.content: The store page of DLC "Artwork" and "After Story" have been retired. The content of "After Story" would be contained within the game itself. For players love any artwork in the game, right click the screen to hide the subtitle and press F12 to screenshot. The feature of downloading all artworks in a package would not be available.

notes.title: Game Release Time
notes.content: This game may not be released in 2024, and the specific release time will be announced later.

notes.title: New tracks added in Soundtrack
notes.content:
"Heart of a Caged Bird - Soundtrack" has added two new tracks, and some tracks have been renamed.

Regarding the development progress of the game: The storyboard of a key scene is still being designed, most of the other illustrations have been completed, and some special effects need to be added. It is expected to be released in 2024.

notes.title: The Release will be postponed
notes.content: Due to financial problems, the release will be postponed to 2023 or 2024.

notes.title: "Heart of a Bird in a Cage" will be postponed to release in 2022
notes.content: "Heart of a Bird in a Cage" just had an alpha test, the test result is very unsatisfactory. The reason is that the CGs are all illustrated separately, when they form a story together the stage effect is very poor, so more than half of the CGs may have to be redrawn, and we are also considering finding a director. Although "Heart of a Bird in a Cage" is free, the game is still made in earnest. Sorry for this bad news.
